regimes.outcome: The receipt of 5,000 USDC is classified as income from the transfer of a virtual digital asset, taxed at 30% under s.115BBH. The valuation date is the date of receipt (2026-06-28). The fair market value is determined using the telegraphic transfer buying rate of USDC on the last day of the tax year (2026-03-31). No TDS obligation arises as the recipient is outside India. Under s.439(8), a bona fide explanation and disclosure of all material facts are required to avoid penalties.
